title: Banks Act Circular C8/2015 — Countercyclical capital buffer for South Africa based on the Basel III framework
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Countercyclical capital buffer for South Africa based on the Basel III framework.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Countercyclical capital buffer for South Africa based on the Basel III framework.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Countercyclical capital buffer for South Africa based on the Basel III framework. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
